about_the_game:
"The truth belongs only to those who survive."

The utopia controlled by the super-AI Lazarus collapsed overnight.
All connected humanity lost their free will and began hunting survivors as zombies.

Only you, the 'Runt' who was despised for not being connected, have survived.
Will you destroy Lazarus amidst the chaos, or restore order to rebuild it?
Your choice will determine the fate of humanity.

⚔️ The Two Ways to Survive

Survival Of Runt presents two distinct multiplayer modes. Choose the battlefield that fits your instinct.

1. THE DEADZONE (40 Minutes of Living Hell)

A hardcore battle royale where up to 50 survivors clash in a shrinking zone.

  • High Stakes Gamble (Betting Time)

    • High Risk: Upon death, 30 minutes of your remaining life is immediately reclaimed.

    • High Return: Survive until the end to win a massive 2 to 5 hours of lifespan.

  • Order or Chaos?

    • 🔵 Order (Cooperation): Form a squad and reach the Top 4. Upon success, +2 hours are granted to each member.

    • 🔴 Chaos (Betrayal): Trust no one. Only the Top 1 survivor can receive the exclusive +5 hours.

    • The Twist: You cannot know what others have chosen. You won't know if the ally watching your back is a guardian of order or a traitor until the moment of your death.

  • Death is Revenge

    • Have you fallen? Do not despair. You will resurrect as a 'Zombie'. The more you die, the more you evolve into a powerful monster to hunt down the survivors.

2. CONQUEST (The Endless War)

A massive, server-wide epic played out on a persistent server.

  • Active Control

    • Simply planting a flag is not enough. If activity stops, the shield breaks, and anyone can target your territory.

    • Conversely, constant activity raises your control level, making your flag invulnerable to attacks.

  • Expand & Survive

    • Expand your territory in barren lands and secure resources. In Conquest, your time is slowly consumed every moment you are active.

[Economy System: The Value of Time]

⏳ The Price of Existence: Time Economy

The only resource sustaining this vast world is 'Time'.
If your Time hits 0, you can no longer play. However, we offer fair opportunities.

Play to Survive (Eternal Life through Effort)

  • Complete Weekly Quests and in-game activities to regain lost life (Game Time). For those who strive, death is postponed.

Buy to Save Time (Buying Convenience)

  • Running low on time? You can purchase 'Time Gold' to extend your life.

  • But remember: Money buys you 'Convenience', not 'Power'. Bullets on the battlefield do not discriminate between the rich and the poor.

[Technological Singularity: A Living World]

🤖 Technological Singularity

 Evolved AI:

  • Enemies do not follow set paths. They scale walls, crawl on ceilings, and target your blind spots. Even the walls of your fortress are just another path to them.

  • Destructible Open World:

    Every building has a unique internal structure. Buildings are destroyed module by module, opening new paths according to your strategy.

🚧 Under Development (Roadmap)

"Your allies understand your words."

We are currently developing an NPC Command Recognition System using LLM (Large Language Model). Instead of pressing assigned keys, give commands naturally via voice or chat. Your AI allies will understand your intent and react tactically. (Future Update)

"Will you restore Lazarus for justice?
Or will you destroy everything for instinct?"

Make your choice. Time is running out.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is set in a zombie survival environment and includes violent depictions such as bloodstains and dismemberment.
It does not contain any content related to sexual assault, non-consensual sexual acts, explicit sexual behavior, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
Players who are sensitive to violent content are advised to take this into consideration when playing the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 / RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: The truth belongs only to those who survive." 50 players bet their actual lifespan (Time) to enter the DEADZONE, or write a grand epic in CONQUEST. In a world where order has collapsed, what will define you? Death is not the end. Rise as a Zombie to hunt survivors and reclaim your lost time.
